question: Robustness of the Python API, HTTP /v1/systemone and web UI to edge cases

part2_python_http_inproc.source: part2.log; 7 FAILs are NameError test bug, 1 wrong expectation

part3_http_cli_ui_server.source: results_part3.json; server 'python -m laya_vision.ui' on port 8793, shut down cleanly; cold first request 34s under GPU contention

part4_modes.note: load(compile=True) ok; image predict raises clear ValueError. Text-only predict under compile=True did not finish within the 600s timeout (inductor compile under a contended GPU/CPU): UNRESOLVED, not a pass/fail.

part4b_nocompile.source: results_part4b.json; the 3 FAILs are the surrogate TypeError (B1)

part2_fail_classification.test: HTTP POST image PNG / BMP / TIFF / RGBA PNG / CMYK JPEG / 1x1 / 7000x7000 (7 checks)
part2_fail_classification.evidence: run_part2.py calls enc() which is not defined in that script (NameError, no request sent). Re-run in part3_http.py with enc defined: all 7 PASS (200/400/400/200/200/200/413).
Image requests need 63 tokens at max_len=64 (head + 49 image tokens + SEP fits exactly; diag _encode_state len=63). max_len=40 correctly gives 422 with a clear message (part3 PASS).

part1_fail_classification.class: wrong tolerance (fp16 padding noise), not a logic bug
part1_fail_classification.evidence: Same-batch repeats are bit-identical (max dp 0); differences only appear with different padding/batch shapes, probabilities in 4dp, max 0.03.

laya_vision.images._from_array only checks the upper pixel limit; zero-size arrays pass load_image (size (0,0)) and predict returns the same probs as a blank 1x1 image. Not reachable over HTTP (cannot encode a 0x0 image).
Clear message 'state must not be None; pass a string, dict, or list'; TypeError is reasonable.

part1_fail_classification.test: 1-option choice / int label keys / noul without criteria / 20k-char instructions / max_len=100000 / head_max_len=8 / long option descriptions: no error
part1_fail_classification.evidence: All return valid normalized outputs; long text is silently truncated to head_max_len / max_len rather than rejected (documented in sequence.py: options are clipped per budget). Caveat: head_max_len=8 is silently accepted.
noul answers have 'noul' not 'probabilities'; HTTP noul request in part3 PASSes.

part1_fail_classification.test: load(fast=True) then image predict: no error
part1_fail_classification.evidence: Without tilelang, load(fast=True) falls back to the stock forward with a warning, so images work. With a simulated _fast object, a clear ValueError is raised (part4b PASS).

real_bugs.title: Lone surrogate (e.g. \ud800 from JSON) in question text, option label or state text -> TypeError -> HTTP 500 'inference failed'
real_bugs.repro: POST /v1/systemone {"state":{"image":<b64>},"questions":{"q":{"type":"choice","instructions":"?","criteria":{"a\ud800":null,"b":null}}}}  (part3_http.py); Python: agent.predict({'text':'hi\ud800'}, Q) -> TypeError: TextEncodeInput must be Union[...] (part4b_nocompile.py). Traceback: laya/common.py encode_text -> tokenizers encode_batch. serve.py maps only ValueError to 422.
